scope: 单张海报的作品级风格提取；制作媒介、创作者及首发出处未核验。

slots.title: 上部的主标题和副标题
slots.base: 下方居中、具有宽底座的主体
slots.module_patterns: 用于填充结构分区的纹样基元
slots.rail: 可选的左侧窄栏短条目

info_rail.en: the activity calls for a short information rail

rules.zh: 使用近墨蓝的书写感标题、明亮的几何器物和细密模块纹样，形成节庆海报。让{{base}}托住中段{{floating_objects}}。
rules.en: Combine a near-ink-blue calligraphic heading, vivid geometric objects and dense modular ornament in a festival poster. Ground {{floating_objects}} with {{base}}.
rules.check: 缩图仍可辨大字、漂浮场和宽底主体。

rules.zh: 背景顶端为浅薰衣草蓝，中部大片近白，底部为浅青柠绿；以墨蓝统一字色。将荧光黄绿、湖蓝、橙和洋红控制在器物与纹饰内。
rules.en: Fade from pale lavender-blue at the top into a broad near-white middle and pale lime at the bottom. Use ink blue for typography. Contain electric lime, cyan, orange and magenta within objects and ornament.
rules.check: 文字暗、背景浅、器物鲜明，近白中段仍可辨。

rules.zh: 采用明亮均匀的平涂观感。仅用相邻色面、薄轮廓和少量色差表示形体转折，背景可渐变。
rules.en: Use an evenly bright flat-color appearance. Convey turns with adjoining planes, thin contours and small color shifts; allow gradients in the background.
rules.check: 无厚重投影、写实高光或统一强方向光。

rules.zh: 将{{title}}置于顶部，{{floating_objects}}错落悬浮在中段，{{base}}居中扎根在下部。{{footer}}占独立的底部带。
rules.en: Put {{title}} at the top, stagger {{floating_objects}} through the middle, anchor {{base}} at the lower center, and give {{footer}} its own footer band.
rules.check: 顶部字、白地器物、下部主体、页脚四区可辨。

rules.zh: 标题与底部主体占最大尺度；漂浮器物用中等尺度互相错开；彩环、短连线和点串用最小尺度。
rules.en: Place the title and lower anchor at the largest scale, stagger medium objects through the field, and keep rings, short connectors and dotted chains smallest.
rules.check: 缩略看有三个尺寸级别，小圆环不会与器物混读。

rules.zh: 将器物拆成圆、条、扇和方形，用干净平涂拼接；{{module_patterns}}在器物表面和底座中重复使用。
rules.en: Build objects from circles, strips, fans and rectangles in clean flat color; repeat {{module_patterns}} on their surfaces and on the base.
rules.check: 关闭小纹样时，器物外形和功能仍可辨认。

rules.zh: 标题用粗细悬殊、收笔有钩或回环的醒目字形。图形用精确硬边和彩色套边，点线边缘只放在局部。
rules.en: Give the heading strong stroke contrast with hooked or looping terminals. Use crisp edges and nested color outlines for graphics, with dotted edges only in select places.
rules.check: 字形可辨，图形边界清楚，边饰保留轮廓。

rules.zh: 器物有足够形态线索可识别，腹部、构件接合和底座纹带展开细节，间隙与文字区保持简洁。
rules.en: Keep identifying cues on objects, enrich their bodies, joins and base bands, and leave gaps and text zones simple.
rules.check: 细节沿结构分区，关键剪影和字没有被纹饰侵入。

rules.zh: 用规则重复的条纹、棋格、同心环或点列形成可见纹理，保留无颗粒的干净色面。
rules.en: Build visible texture from regularly repeated stripes, checks, concentric rings or dot rows, leaving clean, grain-free color planes.
rules.check: 纹理来自重复构件，近看颜色边界仍清楚。

rules.zh: 从可辨认的{{floating_objects}}中提取关键外轮廓后再几何化；外围的小圆、彩点和弧线保持分散。
rules.en: Retain the distinctive silhouettes of {{floating_objects}} before geometrizing them; scatter small circles, colored dots and arcs loosely around them.
rules.check: 主体图符与装饰记号区分明显。

rules.zh: 将密度收进器物内部和底座纹带，中段器物之间保留连续白地。启用侧栏时，将{{rail}}独立对齐在窄列内。
rules.en: Concentrate density within objects and base bands; preserve continuous white space between middle objects. When enabled, align {{rail}} independently in a narrow column.
rules.check: 侧栏与图符可分别扫描，白地连通且不会被装饰填满。

rules.zh: 先用深色大标题建立阅读入口，再由明艳器物和宽底主体吸引视线向下，最终落在底部信息。
rules.en: Use the dark headline as the reading entry, draw the eye down through vivid objects and the broad anchor, and finish at the footer.
rules.check: 读序清楚，器物不会遮挡主字或信息。

rules.zh: 用端正的暗色文字对照明亮玩具般的器物，用稳固的底部中轴对照中段悬浮感，表现庄重而有庆典活力的气氛。
rules.en: Contrast composed dark typography with vivid toy-like objects, and a stable lower axis with a floating middle field, for lively yet dignified celebration.
rules.check: 字图、稳动与密疏三组对照同时成立。
